name: gitframes
description: Author, render and verify video compositions with the gitframes WebGPU SDK.

interface.longDescription:
Gitframes teaches your coding agent to make videos with code. The skills cover setting up a project with the gitframes npm package, building compositions (layout, typography, keyframed animation, 3D scenes, audio), applying effects and color grading, on-device vision such as subject cutouts and tracking, and rendering: single frames, contact sheets, and MP4 export with built-in QA. Everything renders natively on WebGPU in Node.js, without a browser or desktop creative suite.

Intended for developers and agents producing motion graphics, product videos, and programmatic films. Limitations: the plugin contains skills only; rendering needs Node.js 22 or later and a WebGPU-capable GPU (Metal or Vulkan), and the vision features download open model weights from Hugging Face on first use. gitframes is in beta, so APIs may change.
defaultPrompt: Set up gitframes in this project and render a 3-second title card.

publication.release_notes: Adds the gitframes onboarding skill for setting up a project and a first verified render, and fixes the frame-grid example in gitframes-render.
